# Design System

A token-driven component library built from a Figma source of truth.
Follows shadcn/ui conventions. Black/white base with semantic color roles.

## Tech Stack

- React 18
- TypeScript 5
- Tailwind CSS 4 (utility classes driven by CSS variables)
- class-variance-authority (CVA) for component variants
- Style Dictionary 4 (Figma JSON → CSS variables)
- Storybook 8 (visual documentation)
- Vite 5 (build tool)

## Structure

```
src/
  components/ui/   ← All components live here (shadcn-style, lowercase filenames)
    button.tsx
  stories/         ← Storybook stories (one per component)
    button.stories.tsx
  lib/
    utils.ts       ← cn() helper (clsx + tailwind-merge)
  global.css       ← Tailwind entry + @import of token CSS variables

tokens/
  figma/           ← Source of truth exported from Figma (never edit manually)
  transformed/
    css/
      variables.css       ← Light-mode CSS custom properties (:root)
      variables-dark.css  ← Dark-mode overrides ([data-theme="dark"])
    ts/
      tokens.ts           ← TypeScript token constants
  style-dictionary.config.js  ← Build config
```

## Components

### Button — `src/components/ui/button.tsx`

```tsx
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'

// Variants: primary | secondary | ghost | negative
// Sizes:    lg | md | sm | xs

<Button variant="primary" size="md">Save changes</Button>
<Button variant="secondary">Cancel</Button>
<Button variant="ghost">Learn more</Button>
<Button variant="negative">Delete account</Button>

// States
<Button isLoading>Saving…</Button>
<Button disabled>Unavailable</Button>

// Icons
<Button leftIcon={<PlusIcon />}>Add item</Button>
<Button rightIcon={<ArrowRightIcon />}>Continue</Button>
```

Props: `variant`, `size`, `isLoading`, `leftIcon`, `rightIcon`, `disabled`, `className`, `data-testid`, all native `<button>` attributes. Supports `ref` forwarding.

## Design Tokens

All color, spacing, radius, and typography values are CSS custom properties.
They are defined in `tokens/transformed/css/variables.css` and imported via `src/global.css`.

**Critical:** Any file that uses components from this library must import the CSS variables.
In a Vite/Next.js project: `import '@your-username/design-system/tokens/css'`
In a standalone HTML file: copy the contents of `tokens/transformed/css/variables.css` into a `<style>` tag.

Key token groups:
- `--action-primary` / `--action-primary-inverse` → primary button fill / text
- `--action-distructive` → negative/destructive button fill
- `--content-primary` / `--content-secondary` → text colors
- `--surface-primary` / `--background-screen` → backgrounds
- `--border-outline` / `--border-divider` → borders
- `--state-focus-ring` (#068BEE) → focus ring, always visible
- `--corner-radius-corner-medium` (8px) → default border radius
- `--spacing-space-*` → spacing scale (2px → 64px)

Never hardcode color, spacing, radius, or font values. Always use CSS variables.

## Using in Another Project

```bash
npm install github:omagood/design-system
```

```tsx
// 1. Import the token CSS (required — without this, components render unstyled)
import '@your-username/design-system/tokens/css'

// 2. Import components
import { Button } from '@your-username/design-system'

export default function App() {
  return <Button variant="primary">Hello</Button>
}
```

## Updating Tokens from Figma

1. Export tokens from Figma (Tokens Studio plugin → Export → W3C JSON)
2. Replace files in `tokens/figma/`
3. Run `npm run tokens:build`
4. Commit the updated `tokens/transformed/` files

## Running Locally

```bash
npm install
npm run storybook   # Component browser at http://localhost:6006
npm run dev         # Vite dev server
npm run typecheck   # TypeScript check
npm run tokens:build  # Rebuild CSS variables from Figma JSON
```
